headline: Sensex Jumps 700 Points to Cross 25,700 Bucking Early Global Selloff

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Weak global cues and a sell-off in AI stocks initially weighed on market sentiment.
GIFT Nifty plunged over 200 points following a 2.3% fall in Nasdaq and weak Asian markets.
Profit-taking and expectations of Fed rate hikes led to an early decline in indices.
Markets managed to buck early weakness as Sensex staged a massive intraday recovery.
whatHappening: Sensex recovered early losses to jump 700 points, driving Nifty above 25,700.
Newly-listed companies added ₹32 trillion to BSE market capitalization in 2026.
Urban Company raised ₹2,500 crore via QIP with demand exceeding ₹15,000 crore.
Gold prices fell to their lowest level of 2026 amid global market movements.
summary: Indian benchmark indices opened lower amid weak global sentiment and tech sell-offs before rebounding sharply. Sensex surged 700 points to push Nifty above the 25,700 mark during trade. Corporate actions were highlighted by major QIPs and fundraises alongside listing gains in 2026.
